title: sophora macnabiana
intro: Sophora macnabiana, commonly known as Kaufer's sophora, is a species of flowering plant in the legume family, Fabaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sophora macnabiana include its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, as well as its use as a sedative and antiseptic. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, saponins, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
